body: ac-00: re-baseline 4 numeric clusters' FP rate on shipped default v19 (utc/url/boolean->integer, integer->decimal); drop any already ~0 on v19
All four clusters survive re-baseline on v19 (utc 0.837, bool 0.993, url 1.000, int->dec 1.000). None drop. See output/v24-numeric-precision/rebaseline_v19.md
ac-01: extract numeric-target hard negatives (4 clusters, safety>=0.80), MADR 0056 leakage dedup, zero categorical, -> output/v24-numeric-precision/hard_negatives.parquet
78,612 hard negatives, all 4 clusters non-zero, zero categorical asserted, MADR 0056 dedup 56 dropped. output/v24-numeric-precision/hard_negatives.parquet
ac-02 DONE-partial: v19 Sense-dist baseline + blend audit PASSED (251,270 rows, 0 categorical). REMAINS: FTMB-level audit (VALID_DIM=240/cap/per-type) — coupled to cap decision below
ac-03 BLOCKED on cap decision: spec says cap<=600 (ac-02) vs ~1200 (ac-03); v23 used 1800. Pick before FTMB prepare + train 3 seeds

Cap RESOLVED: 1800 (author decision 2026-06-03 'match v23, use cap 1800 and train'). Keeps v24 a clean data-composition delta over v23. Script scripts/overnight_v24_numeric.sh launched in tmux session v24-retrain: 3 seeds (42/43/44), 50 epochs, patience 15, NO --include-column-level-types. Outputs models/sherlock-v24-numeric-relu-s{42,43,44}.

ac-04/ac-05 eval verdict (in progress 2026-06-05): v24 trades target numeric FPs for a NEW coordinate.latitude FP family. Corpus snapshot coordinate.latitude 10->91 (9x), longitude 17->38; earthquake relabels 6 plain decimals (mag/dmin/rms/horizontalError/depthError/magError) as latitude + type->periodicity(pass0) => earthquake precision regresses 0.0130/grade C -> 0.0583/grade F. FP drop uneven: bool->int -56pct, int->dec -100pct, utc -4pct, url 0pct (untouched). Leaning NO-GO on promotion + re-litigation memo per ac-04. Confirming magnitude with matched fresh-binary snapshots (snap_v19_clean/snap_v24_clean).

NO-GO confirmed on matched fresh-binary snapshots. ac-04 FAILED both components: (a) FP drop net-negative (utc corpus 50->256, url untouched; only bool/int->dec won); (b) collateral coordinate.latitude 15->65 4.3x, longitude 16->44, region ~1.7x -- categorical AVOIDED (1.01->0.86) but geography/coordinate exploded instead. ac-05 recall holds but earthquake C->F. Re-litigation memo: output/v24-numeric-precision/relitigation_memo.md. Memory v24-numeric-retrain-failed-coordinate-explosion. Default stays v19; v24 not promoted/published.

Moot: v24 closed Failed at ac-04 (coordinate.latitude explosion, see relitigation_memo.md). The remaining FTMB-level audit (VALID_DIM/cap/per-type) was a pre-train gate for a bet that has now failed at eval; not pursuing. Training did complete (3 seeds val_acc 0.944) so the cap-1800 build was valid; the failure is data-composition negative transfer, not an audit miss.
Cap resolved (1800), v24 trained 3 seeds + evaluated. Eval closed NO-GO (relitigation_memo.md); spec closing Failed.
